text:
maya: quick PSA — I pulled the KMS grant audit for the last 30d and noticed 3 cross-account grants + 7 service accounts with admin-level bindings that have no owner evidence in the attestation tool (last evidence >9 months). thinking a short "who-needs-admin" pulse to reduce blast radius. any objections?
jason: can you paste the query/output? want to cross-check with the svcacct inventory.
maya: pasted snippet: ```bash
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt" AND resource.labels.key_ring="prod-keyring"' --freshness=30d --format=json | jq '.[] | {time: .timestamp, principal: .protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, grant: .protoPayload.authorizationInfo}'
```
sec-bot: ALERT: KMS_GRANT_CROSS_ACCOUNT detected (rule=kms-crossacct-1) — 3 events in past 24h. See audit: https://console.audit/redwood/logs/xyz (redacted)
rachel: @maya can you list the svcacct ids? i'll run entitlement-scan and check last-used timestamps.
maya: svcacct list (redacted): svc-data-agg@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com, svc-ml-ingest@..., svc-deploy-bot@... — two of these currently have roles/editor and one has roles/owner on project:prod-analytics.
alex: quick ops Q — do we have a canary prune flow? i'd rather demote to view-only with short-lived bindings first instead of full removal.
jason: proposed workflow: 1) notify owners via email + slack (48h) 2) if no owner/evidence, apply reduce-to-view IAM binding (24h) with audit-only flag and short TTL 3) if suspicious activity, escalate to oncall for emergency revoke. i'll draft a minimal playbook.
oncall: ack. if you're making IAM changes, ping before the window so oncall can monitor. also save an export of the audit slice for the incident record.
rachel: i can run entitlement-scan + evidence-synth report by EOD and open the tracker. maya pls add owner list and attach logs.
maya: owners added to the thread: @zack, @mina, @ops-east. emailing owners now. sharing logs + scripts: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abc123 (redacted).
jason: LGTM. rachel — can you capture the ticket and assign to sec-triage?
rachel: creating ticket INC-2024-987 and assigning sec-triage, tagging security/platform/oncall.
sec-bot: NOTE: ticket INC-2024-987 created by rachel at 2024-11-05T16:45Z (automated).
maya: thanks all. next steps: monitor for owner response 48h, then action per playbook. please post any objections here. @everyone :thumbsup:
alex: :thumbsup:
